name: @intellectual-frontiers/repoctl
description: Repoctl, the operations program of a repository, driven by its typed repoctl.config.ts: it makes the generated files in dependency order, merges without hand-resolving them, runs every named check in one report, makes the commit with the repository's identity and trailers and says what is wrong with a checkout; where the configuration turns them on it also tells the versions, releases, scaffolds a library, proves a change and builds the documentation.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun ../kanon/src/check.ts && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/
